## What Makes Kansas City Dumpster Rentals Different

1. **Free driveway board protection on every delivery.** Wooden boards are placed under every dumpster at every delivery, no exceptions and no extra charge. This protects concrete and asphalt driveways from the weight and contact of the container.

2. **Tight-spot specialists.** Kansas City's historic neighborhoods (Midtown, Hyde Park, Westport, Brookside, Waldo, Columbus Park, Crossroads) have narrow gangway driveways that national chains cannot or will not navigate. Kansas City Dumpster Rentals does these deliveries regularly with the right equipment.

3. **Same-day delivery available.** Subject to schedule availability. Call as early in the morning as possible for same-day service. Most KC competitors require 24-48 hours lead time.

4. **Locally owned, not a franchise.** A real person picks up the phone. No call centers, no hold music.

5. **Transparent pricing.** The price quoted is the price paid. No hidden fuel surcharges or administrative fees.

## Dumpster Sizes Available

### 13-Yard Roll-Off Dumpster
- Height: 4 feet
- Length: 14 feet
- Width: 8 feet
- Footprint: 14 x 8 feet (same as all three sizes)
- Best for: Small garage cleanouts, single-room renovations, small landscaping jobs, minor junk removal

### 17-Yard Roll-Off Dumpster
- Height: 5 feet
- Length: 14 feet
- Width: 8 feet
- Footprint: 14 x 8 feet (same as all three sizes)
- Best for: Whole-home cleanouts, multi-room renovations, deck or fence removal, estate cleanouts. This is the most popular size.

### 21-Yard Roll-Off Dumpster
- Height: 6 feet
- Length: 14 feet
- Width: 8 feet
- Footprint: 14 x 8 feet (same as all three sizes)
- Best for: Roofing jobs, large construction projects, full property cleanouts with high debris volume

**Key insight:** All three sizes share the same 14 x 8 ft driveway footprint. Only the height changes. A driveway that fits the 13-yard fits the 21-yard. Size selection is based on debris volume, not available space.

## Pricing

Rental pricing varies by size. Contact Kansas City Dumpster Rentals at (404) 759-4361 for current rates. All rentals include:
- Delivery to your location
- 7-day rental period
- Free wooden driveway board protection
- Base weight allowance (varies by size)
- Pickup and disposal at a licensed facility
- No fuel surcharges or hidden fees

### Additional Fees
- **Extension:** $20 per day beyond the 7-day rental period (call before expiry)
- **Weight overage:** $75 per ton above the included weight allowance
- **Failed-trip fee:** $100 if our truck arrives but cannot complete delivery (blocked access, no permit for street placement, inaccessible location)
- **Swap-out / dump-and-return:** $200 flat (pickup full dumpster, dump at facility, return empty)
- **Outside service area surcharge:** $100 flat for deliveries 36-50 miles from Kansas City center. Beyond 50 miles: declined or custom quote.

## Cancellation Policy
- 24 or more hours before scheduled delivery: Free cancellation, full refund of any deposit
- Under 24 hours before scheduled delivery: $50 cancellation fee
- After truck is dispatched: $100 failed-trip fee

## What Can Go in the Dumpster (Accepted Items)
- Household furniture (sofas, chairs, tables, mattresses, bed frames)
- Household junk and general debris
- Construction and renovation materials (drywall, lumber, flooring, insulation, windows, doors)
- Roofing materials (shingles, underlayment, decking - heavy, may cause weight overage)
- Yard waste (branches, brush, sod, dirt - heavy, may cause weight overage)
- Concrete and masonry (heavy, may cause weight overage)
- Appliances WITHOUT Freon (stoves, dishwashers, washers, dryers)
- Electronics (check with us first)
- Cardboard and paper
- Clothing and textiles

## What CANNOT Go in the Dumpster (Prohibited Items)
- **Hazardous materials:** Paint, solvents, gasoline, chemicals, pesticides, herbicides, pool chemicals
- **Freon-containing appliances:** Refrigerators, freezers, air conditioning units, dehumidifiers
- **Tires** (all sizes)
- **Batteries** (car batteries, lithium batteries)
- **Propane tanks** (full or empty)
- **Asbestos-containing materials**
- **Medical waste or biohazards**
- **Hot ashes or embers**

When in doubt, call before loading: (404) 759-4361.

## Loading Rules
- Fill to the rim (level with the top of the sidewalls). This is a perfectly full dumpster.
- Do NOT load debris above the sidewalls. Overfilled dumpsters cannot be legally transported and are a safety hazard.
- Distribute heavy items on the bottom and fill gaps with lighter material.
- Break down large items (furniture, boxes) before loading to maximize space.
- If you overfill, you must remove the excess before pickup can occur.

## How Dumpster Rental Works in Kansas City

**Step 1: Call or Text to Book**
Call or text (404) 759-4361. Tell us your project, your preferred delivery date, and where you want the dumpster placed. We confirm availability and give you a price on the spot. Same-day delivery is available subject to schedule.

**Step 2: We Deliver Your Dumpster**
Our truck arrives at the scheduled time. We place wooden boards under the dumpster to protect your driveway and position the container precisely where you need it. We serve the full KC metro including tight historic neighborhood driveways.

**Step 3: Fill It at Your Pace**
Load your debris over the 7-day rental period. Fill it to the rim (not above). Call for an early pickup when you are done, or call to extend your rental at $20/day if you need more time.

**Step 4: We Pick Up and Haul Away**
When you are ready, call and we schedule pickup. We haul everything to a licensed disposal facility, remove the boards, and leave your driveway as we found it.

## Permit Information for Kansas City

**Driveway or private property placement:** No permit required. This is the most common placement and the simplest option.

**Street or sidewalk placement:** A right-of-way permit from the appropriate city public works department is required BEFORE delivery. This is the customer's responsibility. Kansas City Dumpster Rentals does not pull permits on behalf of customers.

Kansas City, MO Public Works: (816) 513-2600
Other municipalities have their own processes. Call your local public works department before booking.

If our truck arrives and cannot place the dumpster due to a missing permit, a $100 failed-trip fee applies.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How much does a dumpster rental cost in Kansas City?**
A: Pricing varies by dumpster size. Contact us at (404) 759-4361 for current rates. Every rental includes delivery, 7 days, free driveway boards, base weight allowance, and pickup. No hidden fees.

**Q: What size dumpster do I need?**
A: 13-yard for small projects (single room, small garage). 17-yard for whole-home cleanouts and multi-room renovations (most popular). 21-yard for roofing, large construction, and full property cleanouts. All three share the same 14x8 ft footprint, so choose by debris volume.

**Q: Can I get same-day dumpster delivery in Kansas City?**
A: Yes, subject to schedule availability. Call as early as possible in the morning.

**Q: Do I need a permit for a dumpster rental in Kansas City?**
A: Not if it's on your driveway or private property. Street or sidewalk placement requires a right-of-way permit from your city (customer's responsibility).

**Q: How long is the rental period?**
A: 7 days, with $20/day extensions available.

**Q: Do you serve narrow driveways and KC historic neighborhoods?**
A: Yes. Midtown, Hyde Park, Westport, Brookside, Waldo, Columbus Park are specialties. We navigate tight gangway driveways that national chains often decline.

**Q: What if I fill the dumpster before my rental ends?**
A: Call us for a swap-out (dump-and-return) at $200 flat.

**Q: What is your cancellation policy?**
A: Free cancellation 24+ hours before delivery. $50 fee under 24 hours. $100 failed-trip fee if truck is dispatched.

**Q: Do you provide driveway protection?**
A: Yes, free on every delivery. Wooden boards are placed under every dumpster, no exceptions.

**Q: What are your hours?**
A: Monday through Sunday, 8 AM to 6 PM Central Time.

**Q: Are you locally owned?**
A: Yes. Not a franchise. A real KC-area operator answers the phone directly.
